rule.name: Authentication
rule.rule_desc: A file or directory name matches the authentication review area. This check inspects paths, not the implementation or a reachable execution path.
rule.vuln_desc: If identity or resource authorization can be bypassed, an attacker may impersonate a user, access another user’s data, or perform restricted operations. A control’s presence alone does not establish a weakness. A filename match alone does not establish this consequence.
rule.developer: Enforce authentication and object-level authorization on the trusted server or privileged boundary. Use strong verifier material, appropriate rate limits and recovery controls, and test access by unauthenticated and insufficiently privileged callers.
rule.reviewer: Verify the presence and correctness of authentication-related code. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.reviewer: Verify the presence and correctness of code paths related to libraries, extensions, or plugins. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
